title: Author Notes: RAG for Your Story Bible
use_cases: Implement when users need their world-building notes automatically referenced during content generation
Configure when character consistency is required across long-form narrative arcs
Use when dynamic retrieval of story bible elements is needed without manual tagging
Use when managing large amounts of background lore that exceeds standard context limits
content:
The RAG system doesn't just work for story summaries. It also powers the Author Tools Integration.

In the Story Planner, you can create:

- Character profiles
- World-building notes
- Plot outlines

These notes are stored in the same RAG database. When you're generating new story content, the system automatically retrieves relevant notes based on what you're writing.

For example:

- If you're writing a scene with a specific character, their character profile gets retrieved
- If you mention a location, world-building notes about that location get included
- If you're advancing a subplot, the relevant plot notes come along

This happens automatically in the background. You don't need to manually attach notes or remember to reference them. The semantic search handles it.

The system allocates up to 4,000 tokens for Author Notes combined, so even with detailed character profiles and extensive world-building, the AI has access to your story bible without overwhelming its context window.
